about: Which RedFoxOS image suits a computer, from its PCI display devices (vendor and device id, lower-case hex without 0x). The one rule set for RedFox Hub's '(Recommended)' (redfox-rollback-helper) and the download page on redfoxlabs.tech. Each display device gets the first class it matches, or 'other'; then the first rule whose 'all' classes are all present and whose 'none' classes are all absent gives the answer. image null means no recommendation. hybrid marks built-in graphics next to an NVIDIA card (a laptop, usually). Test cases: tests/gpu-cases.json.
